target.summary: Pad handle lookups via `FindHandleKeyByHandle` in `scePadGetControllerInformation` mismanage controller handle resolution and leave `deviceClass` set to `Invalid`. This causes controller detection and input to break in games such as Unity titles.
notes: sets deviceClass to Invalid when handle lookup fails or device class is not matched
call site of FindHandleKeyByHandle in scePadGetControllerInformation
